description: High-quality photograph by Liat Portal showing a square sheet of matza with its characteristic perforations and toasted spots, photographed on a dark tabletop. This image documents matza, an unleavened flatbread traditionally eaten during Passover, as part of the Foodie Disorder global food culture archive.
